title: Grateful Dead Live at San Jose State University on 1969-10-31
source: This is a Droncit restoration of source ID 3337 using Diamond Cut Forensics 9 Alpha 8

ai_review.summary: Fantastic Halloween show with solid setlist and great performances, but a cloudy, hiss‑laden soundboard recording.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the musical strength of this late‑1969 performance – every song is described as solid, with highlights like “Easy Wind,” the early China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition and a monster “That’s It For The Other One.” The recording, however, suffers from cloudiness and noticeable hiss despite being a restored soundboard source, leaving it in need of further clean‑up.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for the show (70% weight) outweighs the modest recording quality issues (30% weight), yielding an overall rating just above 4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cloudy sound with noticeable hiss; reviewers note it needs further cleaning but is not the worst of the archive.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
That's It For The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Every song is described as solid; early transition from China to Riders and strong Halloween energy make the set flow smoothly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for well‑sung vocals (funny “cuz I'm hunting on top of the world” line) and overall great playing.
